title: EverCompass Universal Response
description: One respondent answer to one criterion (Design Spec §5, §7). An /assess request body is an array of these.

criterion_id.description: Must match a criterion.id in the pinned diagnostic_version's definition.

value.description: 1-5 maturity value, or null when applicability is not_applicable (Design Spec §7).

evidence.description: Supporting explanation. Separate from the score; never reinterpreted by the deterministic engine (Design Spec §5).
